source_text: Exitus autem illi abiecto quis? \'ab igni\', inquiunt, \'creatoris deprehendetur\'. adeone nullum habet elemeutum uel in hanc causam prouisum, quo peccatores suos uel sine saeuitia releget, ne illos dedat creatori? quid tunc creator? credo. sulphuratiorem eis gehennam praeparabit, ut blasphemis suis scilicet; nisi quod deus zelotes fortassean desertoribus aduersarii sui parcat. o deum usquequaque peruersum, ubique inrationalem, in omnibus uanum, atque ita neminem! cuius non statum, non condicionem, non naturam, non ullum ordinem uideo consistere, iam nec ipsum fidei eius sacramentum. cui enim rei baptisma quoque apud eum exigitur? si remissio delictorum est, quomodo uidebitur delicta dimittere qui non uidebitur retinere, quia, si retineret, iudicaret? si absolutio mortis est, quomodo absoluet a morte qui non deuinxit ad mortem? damnasset enim, si a primordio deuinxisset. si regeneratio est hominis, quomodo regenerat qui non generauit? iteratio enim non competit ei, a quo quid nec semel factum est. si consecutio est spiritus sancti, quomodo spiritum adtribuet qui animam non prius contulit? quia suffectura est quodammodo spiritus animae. signat igitur hominem numquam apud se resignatum, lauat hominem numquam apud se coinquinatum. et in hoc totum salutis sacramentum carnem mergit exortem salutis? nec rusticus terram rigabit fructum non relaturam. nisi tam uanus quam deus Marcionis. proinde. cum tantam sine sarcinam siue gloriam infirmissimae aut indignissimae carni imponit sanctitatem, quid aut onerat infirmam aut exornat indignam? quid non salute remunerat quam onerat uel exornat? quid fraudat mercedem operis, non rependens carni salutem? quid et honorem sanctitatis in illa mori patitur?
pass_a_gloss: But what kind of exit will that one have, having been cast out? They say, 'he will be seized by the creator's fire'. Does he not have any element or provision for this cause, by which he may release his sinners even without savagery, so that he may not hand them over to the creator? What then is the creator? I believe. He will prepare for them a sulphurous Gehenna, clearly for his blasphemers; unless perhaps the God who is zealous will spare those who desert his adversary. Oh, a God who is utterly perverse, everywhere irrational, vain in all things, and thus not one person! I do not see his status, condition, nature, or any order consist; now not even the sacrament of his faith. For what thing is baptism also required among them? If it is remission of sins, how will he seem to forgive sins who does not seem to retain them, because if he were to retain them, he would judge? If it is release from death, how will he release from death one who did not bind to death? For he would have condemned if he had bound from the beginning. If it is regeneration of man, how does he regenerate one who he did not generate? For repetition is not suitable for one from whom nothing was ever done. If it is the conferring of the Holy Spirit, how will he bestow the Spirit who did not previously impart a soul? Because the Spirit will in some way supply what is lacking to the soul. Therefore, he signs a man who was never signed by him, washes a man who was never defiled by him. And in this, does he immerse the whole sacrament of salvation in the flesh which arises from salvation? Nor will a farmer water the earth which will not produce fruit. Unless he is as vain as the God of Marcion. Therefore, when he imposes such great sanctity without burden or glory on the weakest or most unworthy flesh, what does he burden the weak flesh with or adorn the unworthy flesh with? What does he not repay with salvation which he burdens or adorns? What does he defraud of the reward of work, not repaying the flesh with salvation? What does he allow the honor of sanctity to die in that flesh?
pass_b_english: But what kind of exit awaits the one who has been cast out? 'He will be seized by the creator's fire,' they say. Does the creator have no element or provision for this purpose, by which he might release his sinners even without savagery, so that he does not hand them over to the creator? What then is the creator? I believe he will prepare a more sulphurous Gehenna for them, expressly for his blasphemers; unless perhaps the zealous God will spare those who desert his adversary. Oh, a God utterly perverse, everywhere irrational, vain in all things, and therefore no one at all! I do not see his status, his condition, his nature, or any order of his consist; now not even the sacrament of his faith holds together. For what thing is baptism also required among them? If it is remission of sins, how will he seem to forgive sins when he does not seem to retain them, because if he were to retain them, he would judge? If it is release from death, how will he release from death one whom he did not bind to death? For he would have condemned if he had bound from the beginning. If it is regeneration of man, how does he regenerate one whom he did not generate? For repetition does not suit one from whom nothing was ever done even once. If it is the conferring of the Holy Spirit, how will he bestow the Spirit who did not previously impart a soul? Because the Spirit will in some way supply what is lacking to the soul. Therefore, he signs a man who was never signed by him, washes a man who was never defiled by him. And in this, does he immerse the whole sacrament of salvation in the flesh which arises from salvation? Nor will a farmer water the earth which will not produce fruit. Unless he is as vain as the God of Marcion. Therefore, when he imposes such great sanctity without burden or glory on the weakest or most unworthy flesh, what does he burden the weak flesh with or adorn the unworthy flesh with? What does he not repay with salvation which he burdens or adorns? What does he defraud of the reward of work, not repaying the flesh with salvation? What does he allow the honor of sanctity to die in that flesh?
